darkMode.surfaceRule: Neutral surfaces remain true black; use translucent white hairlines instead of gray panels.

display.purpose: Page titles on surfaces that need one (e.g. 'Add workouts'). The largest type in the app; compact, never a marketing hero.

title.purpose: Section headings, card titles, and the brand mark.

body.purpose: Default copy, controls, inputs, and most metrics; also the AI analysis prose.

label.purpose: Uppercase metric captions under a value and the 'Past analyses' section marker.

shadows.name: ambient-rest
shadows.purpose: Barely-there lift under a resting card; reads as a physical face, not a floating object.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: The response when a card becomes interactive (tappable activity cards).

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for color/shadow state transitions.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Default transition duration for hover/focus state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Globally collapses animation and transition durations; motion-heavy overlays also render without slide transforms.

components.css: .ds-activity-card { max-width:360px; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:12px; background:#ffffff; box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); overflow:hidden; transition:box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-activity-card:hover { box-shadow:0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-ac-head { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:16px; border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9; } .ds-ac-disc { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex:none; width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:9999px; background:#ecfdf5; color:#059669; } .ds-ac-disc svg { width:20px; height:20px; } .ds-ac-meta { min-width:0; flex:1; } .ds-ac-titlerow { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; } .ds-ac-title { font:600 0.875rem/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color:#0f172a; } .ds-badge-gps { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:9999px; background:#ecfdf5; color:#047857; font:500 0.75rem/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-gps svg { width:12px; height:12px; } .ds-ac-date { font:400 0.875rem/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color:#64748b; } .ds-metrics { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4, 1fr); gap:12px; padding:16px; } .ds-metric-value { font:600 0.875rem/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color:#0f172a; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-metric-label { margin-top:2px; font:600 0.6875rem/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.025em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#64748b; }

narrative.overview:
FitSift is a precise measuring instrument for one athlete's training. The chassis is calm matte chrome — near-white surfaces, hairline dividers, a single restrained green — and the readout is the workout data itself: the metrics, the route, the charts, the AI write-up. The interface never competes with the numbers. It holds still so the data can speak, the way a good scale or a watchmaker's loupe disappears in the hand and leaves only the reading.

Restraint is the default, but the instrument is not lifeless. Expression is rationed and spent precisely where it aids comprehension: the sport glyph on an activity card, the emerald focus ring answering a keystroke, the route map, and the model's streamed analysis. These are the lit dials on an otherwise matte panel. Everywhere else, chrome recedes to greyscale.

This system explicitly rejects the vocabulary of consumer-social fitness — no feeds, kudos, likes, leaderboards, streaks, or confetti. There is no one to perform for; this is a private tool for a single user. It equally rejects the cluttered pro dashboard and generic AI-SaaS styling.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white chassis in light mode; true-black, white-hairline chassis in dark.
Border-driven, near-flat surfaces — depth is a response to state, not decoration.
Mobile-first, thumb-friendly (44px minimum targets, safe-area aware).
Data and insight are the only things allowed to be vivid.
System-driven light and AMOLED dark themes, both contrast-verified.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Green appears on ≤10% of any screen. It means 'active' or 'act now.' If two greens compete for attention on one view, one of them is wrong — demote it to slate.

rules.name: The Greyscale-First Rule
rules.body: Structure is built in slate and dividers, never in colour. A border, a tint, or a weight change carries hierarchy before any hue does.

rules.name: The Dark-Mode-Is-First-Class Rule
rules.body: The app follows the system theme. Every dark neutral surface is true black, hierarchy comes from translucent white dividers, and text/icons lift to #34d399. Both themes are held to the same AA bar.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Numbers lead, labels follow and shrink. A metric is a bold Ink value with a small uppercase Slate label beneath it — value first, always.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and separated by borders. Shadow appears only on hover, focus, or genuine overlay. If a static screen needs a shadow to look structured, add a border instead.

dos: Do build structure with Divider hairlines on Surface first; add a shadow only as a hover/focus/overlay response.
Do keep Signal Green to <=10% of a screen and reserve it for action and active state.
Do lead metrics with a bold Ink value and a small uppercase Slate label, using tabular figures so numbers align.
Do keep body text at Slate Muted (#64748b) or darker; put primary reading copy in Ink. Verify >=4.5:1.
Do treat dark mode as first-class: build it, invert the neutral ramp, lift the accent toward #34d399, and re-verify contrast in both themes.
Do preserve the global prefers-reduced-motion fallback and add component-specific alternatives whenever motion carries meaning.
Do keep every tap target >=44px and honour safe-area insets.
donts: Don't import consumer-social patterns — no feeds, likes, kudos, follower counts, leaderboards, streaks, or confetti.
Don't reach for gamification or dopamine mechanics to drive engagement; optimise for insight.
Don't use Slate Faint (#94a3b8) for text that must be read — it fails AA on white.
Don't ship generic AI-SaaS styling: no cream/violet gradients, no gradient text, no hero-metric template, no tracked-uppercase eyebrow on every section.
Don't use border-left/border-right >1px as a coloured accent stripe. Use a full border or a tint.
Don't let a second accent colour creep in. Use weight, size, or Ink for emphasis instead.
Don't stack decorative shadows to fake depth. Reach for a Divider.
